in 2014]] Samwise Didier is a senior art director at Blizzard Entertainment, currently working on Heroes of the Storm. He was one of Blizzard's first artists, joining the company in 1991. Didier's greatly exaggerated physiques and vibrant, bright color palette dictated the artistic style of Warcraft III, World of Warcraft, StarCraft: Ghost and Heroes of the Storm. He has provided art direction or additional art on almost every Blizzard game released to date. Didier also designed and drew many of the graphical icons found in Warcraft III and World of Warcraft, as well as providing voicework for games including Warcraft III, World of Warcraft and Heroes of the Storm. Sand trolls are a subgroup of jungle trolls that dwell in the Tanaris desert. The subgroup arose by adapting to the beating of the hot Tanaris sun after being separated from their Eastern Kingdoms brethren in the Great Sundering. A sand troll empire has never been formed - in fact the only known tribes of sand trolls are the Farraki (also known as the Sandfury) and Sandscalp tribes. Sand trolls mostly keep to themselves and attack all outsiders.

.]] Sand worms (or bursters) are huge worm-like creatures found on both Azeroth and Outland. These worms have burrowing claws growing from the upper body that enable the beasts to dig through most kinds of soil with frightening speed, often surprising unwary prey by bursting up through the ground beneath the creature and killing it with its sharp beak-like mouth. Often times they can be spotted due to the rumbling of the ground above them. Young sand worms seem to be unable to tunnel and also lack the characteristic claws. The massive worm Ouro was the first sand worm to be encountered by the heroes of Azeroth, but more and more have since appeared throughout the world.

Sandsorrow Watch (or simply Sandsorrow) is a massive area just west of Gadgetzan in Tanaris. It's populated by the Farraki tribe trolls and their zombies. Trenton Lighthammer appears to be leading this small camp, where they have also captured and caged up a Sandfury Blood Drinker and Sandfury Zombie. At some point after the Cataclysm, the area, especially Trenton's camp was visited by Aramar Thorne and his friends. Trenton provided him with various supplies. A sanctuary is an area where PvP combat is disabled for all players, and turning on your PvP flag will have no effect until you leave the sanctuary. Sanctuaries were introduced in World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade. Places like Nighthaven and Booty Bay are not sanctuaries; PvP combat is still possible there. Just because PvP combat is disabled, that does not mean that a sanctuary is a safe haven; for example, the monsters on the Stair of Destiny are not PvP NPCs and will attack players if aggroed. The Sanctum of Light, also known as Light's Hope Sanctum, is a secret hall located beneath Light's Hope Chapel. It is a catacomb that houses the remains of a thousand heroes of Lordaeron, which are those of warriors, priests, paladins, and champions of battles long past. It serves as the Order Hall for paladins, and as the headquarters of the Knights of the Silver Hand, led by their new Highlord since the death of Tirion Fordring. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, the order included members of the Argent Crusade, the Blood Knights, the Hand of Argus, the Sunwalkers and other paladin organizations. The Sanctuary of the Light is a subzone of Netherlight Temple. It can be entered from the right of the Hall of Balance. Saa'ra is found here after the initial introductory quests for the class hall have been completed. The Sanctuary of the Void is a subzone of Netherlight Temple it can be entered from the left of The Hall of Balance. Vyr and Gilner Greymoss are found here. The Shadowwell is also found in the center of the room and can only be accessed if the Alters of Blessing advancement is chosen. Following their recruitment by the High Priest, the acolytes of the Cult of Forgotten Shadows, led by Natalie Seline and Aelthalyste, settled in the sanctuary to reform their ranks and support the Conclave in its war against the Burning Legion.

The appearance for the Sandals of the Tidesages is unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Vestments of the Tidesages.
The Sanctuary of the Mad is an area in central Ember Ward and contains the elevator to Sinfall. It also contains a mirror in the crypt to the Shrouded Asylum.
Sandreaver Matriarchs are sand reavers located on the Sunset Shore in Talador.
Sandreaver Drones are sand reavers located on the Sunset Shore in Talador.

Two Sanctum Crystals are fel crystals found on the Fel Hammer after researching Twisting Nether (order advancement). One is found next to Loramus Thalipedes in the Lower Command Center. It transports the player into a platform on the Upper Command Center with a Fel Tome that summons an elite demon. The second crystal allows you to return.
Sand Serpents are snakes located near the Temple of Uldum in Uldum.

The Sanctum of Domination is a raid in World of Warcraft: Shadowlands, introduced in patch 9.1.0. It is located in The Maw, as the uppermost section of Torghast. It is the home base of the Jailer. The raid consists of 10 bosses. Encounters include the true Eye of the Jailer, the Tarragrue, Kel'Thuzad, and Sylvanas Windrunner.
The Sandals of Hooded Nightmares are created with Munificent Treads.

The Sancutary of Guidance is found at the northwest corner of Korthia. Formerly a holy place for the attendants, the area has been taken over by devourers. The area is bordered by the west and north by the Beastwarrens of the Maw, the east by Keeper's Respite, to the southeast by the Scholar's Den, to the south by the unnamed central crossroads, and by the Mauler's Outlook to the southwest.
Sanctum Watchers are ethereals located in the Sanctum of Domination.
Sanctum Gloomcharger's Reins is a Mawhorse mount that drops from the The Nine encounter in Sanctum of Domination.
Sanctum of Domination Guild Run is a guild dungeons & raid achievement earned by defeating all bosses in the Sanctum of Domination on Normal difficulty or higher while in a guild group.
Sandals of Sacred Symmetry are dropped by the Guardian of the First Ones in the Sanctum of Domination.
Sanctified Eredar Lock drops from L'ura in the Seat of the Triumvirate.
Sandals of the Reborn Colossus drop from Aggramar in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Sanctified Guardian's Signet is obtained from multiple sources.
Sandfury Hatchet is a quest reward from Sang'thraze the Deflector (quest).
Sandals of Mycoid Musing drops from Brackenspore in Highmaul and is looted from Cache of Highmaul Treasures.
Sand Sifting Sandals drop from Akkaris at the Arrangement Index in Zereth Mortis.
Sand Matriarch Ileus is a scarabid located at Provis Esper in Zereth Mortis.
Sand, Sand Everywhere! is an exploration achievement earned by uncovering treasures from piles of sand scattered throughout Zereth Mortis. The piles must be opened with a Spatial Opener.
Sandfishing Pole was never made available. It would be used in the Eastern Dunes, seemingly during Sandfishing.

Sanctum of Domination - Damned If You Don't is the usual raid shortcut quest. Defeat Kel'Thuzad four times in the same difficulty to unlock a shortcut to Kel'Thuzad again in future resets. There are three versions of this quest, one for each non-Raid Finder difficulty, and they all track progress separately. However, should players skip ahead and kill four times on Mythic, they will unlock the shortcuts on Normal and Heroic.
Sandals of the Wild Sovereign drop from Raszageth in the Vault of the Incarnates.
The Sanctum of the Claw was a planned subzone found within the Temple of Kimbul in Vol'dun.

Sanctify is a Retribution paladin talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Vanguard's Momentum.
Sandshell Snappers are turtles located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Sandana the Tempest is a rare elite air elemental located inside a cave in Pleasant Hill of southwestern Thaldraszus. This rare is on a fourteen-hour respawn cycle. The mouth of the cave itself is blocked off by a rock wall that requires a miner to open.
Sandhide Watchers are basilisks located just east of Pinchwhistle Point at the coast of the Evanescent Sea in the Spires of Arak.
Sandals of the Honored Valarjar is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Vestment of the Honored Valarjar.

Sand Dunes can be found in the Eye of Azshara in the pools by the shore of the Whispering Willows near the final boss. They are not targetable, and do not show a tooltip when hovering over them with the cursor. They do, however, show up on the mini-map for hunters when they are tracking Elementals, where they are listed by their name and marked as enemies. Sand Dunes are part of the mechanics revolving around defeating Lady Hatecoil during the dungeon. During the battle, Lady Hatecoil will use to electrify the water around her.
